shoppingList.title: Shopping list
shoppingList.description: One grocery item per entry. Quantities are optional: "2 x eggs", "eggs x2" and "2 eggs" all work. Entries may also be comma separated. Up to 50 distinct items.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Where to look for products. "open-prices" (default, no credentials) combines Open Food Facts product data with crowd-sourced shelf prices reported at named stores. "kroger" uses Kroger's official Products API and needs your own Kroger developer credentials below.

enumTitles: Open Food Facts + Open Prices (open data)

maxResultsPerItem.title: Max results per item
maxResultsPerItem.description: How many ranked product offers to return for each shopping list item.

country.title: Country
country.description: ISO country code. Scopes the product search and sets the default currency.

currency.title: Currency override
currency.description: Optional ISO currency code (e.g. USD). Defaults to the country's currency.

maxPriceAgeDays.title: Max price age (days)
maxPriceAgeDays.description: Ignore price observations older than this many days.

retailer.title: Retailer filter
retailer.description: Only keep prices from stores whose name contains this text, e.g. "Walmart" or "Safeway".

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Optional. With longitude, only keep prices from stores near this point.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Optional. With latitude, only keep prices from stores near this point.

includeUnpriced.title: Include products without a known price
includeUnpriced.description: Also return matching products that have no recent price, so every list item resolves to something.

krogerClientId.title: Kroger client ID
krogerClientId.description: From developer.kroger.com. Required only for the Kroger source.

krogerLocationId.title: Kroger store location ID
krogerLocationId.description: 8-character Kroger store ID. Required for prices and stock levels.
